  intro L l
  simp_rw [smallSets_eq_generate, le_generate_iff, image_subset_iff]
  rfl

  (h₂.smallSets.eventually_iff.mp h₁).imp fun _i ⟨hpi, hi⟩ ↦ ⟨hpi, hi Subset.rfl⟩
